import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::AppendResponse","line":1188,"var":"aResponseLength","code":"otError Mle::AppendResponse(Message &aMessage, const uint8_t *aResponse, uint8_t aResponseLength)","note":"The response length comes from the caller and is used to size the outgoing Response TLV."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::AppendResponse","line":1194,"var":"tlv.SetLength(aResponseLength)","code":"tlv.SetLength(aResponseLength);","note":"The TLV length field is set directly from attacker-influenced challenge/response length without clamping to the fixed 8-byte buffer in ResponseTlv."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::AppendResponse","line":1196,"var":"aMessage.Append(aResponse, aResponseLength)","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = aMessage.Append(aResponse, aResponseLength));","note":"The TLV payload bytes are copied into the message using the same length, propagating the oversized length into message construction."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/core/common/message.cpp","function":"Message::Append","line":383,"var":"aLength","code":"otError Message::Append(const void *aBuf, uint16_t aLength)","note":"Append grows the message and then delegates to Write with the requested length, so any oversized TLV length reaches the buffer copy path."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/core/common/message.cpp","function":"Message::Write","line":534,"var":"bytesToCopy","code":"memcpy(GetFirstData() + aOffset, aBuf, bytesToCopy);","note":"Write copies the requested bytes into the message buffer; if the TLV length exceeds the fixed ResponseTlv storage, this becomes an out-of-bounds read from the source object during serialization."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::SendChildUpdateResponse","line":2387,"var":"aChallenge.GetLength()","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = AppendResponse(*message, aChallenge.GetChallenge(), aChallenge.GetLength()));","note":"A received Challenge TLV controls the length passed into AppendResponse when building a Child Update Response, creating the attacker-controlled path to the sink."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleChildUpdateRequest","line":3550,"var":"challenge","code":"if (Tlv::GetTlv(aMessage, Tlv::kChallenge, sizeof(challenge), challenge) == OT_ERROR_NONE)","note":"The peer-supplied Child Update Request is parsed into a Challenge TLV object, so a crafted request can influence the response length used later."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/core/thread/mle_tlvs.hpp","function":"ResponseTlv","line":392,"var":"mResponse","code":"class ResponseTlv : public Tlv","note":"ResponseTlv stores the response bytes in a fixed-size 8-byte array, so any length above that can cause the serializer to read past the object boundary."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
